name: didac-mods
description: Dídac's Claude Code mods for working on a Slurm GPU cluster.

plugins.name: pace-line
plugins.description: Usage band with pace arrows, plus a Slurm batch-job watcher with charts, alerts and auto-resume.

plugins.name: cluster-context
plugins.description: Tells Claude which Slurm node it is on, keeps downloads and HF caches on scratch, and asks before a new allocation.

plugins.name: job-watch
plugins.description: From your own computer: your cluster jobs over one ssh call a minute, with loss, val, GPU-history and sweep charts in the desktop app, and alerts as toasts.

plugins.name: plan-line
plugins.description: Live plan progress bars right above the prompt, with agent strips and sounds; a working fork of plan-progress.

plugins.name: discord-drop
plugins.description: Discord cards through a webhook, only when you're away: results with plots, finished tasks, failed jobs, questions waiting for you.

plugins.name: dev-relay
plugins.description: Keeps the dev-shell alive past Slurm's time limit: a successor job takes over and every Claude session resumes there, carrying on with what it was doing.
